note: Display flavour for the club's own app. Every sourced line needs two independent publishers. Correction found in research: the home shirt is WHITE with a RED sash (RSSSF, Footy Headlines), not red and blue. Left out on purpose, by the sensitivity rules: the 1945 history, anything about supporters' politics or identity, derbies, incidents. No motto, stadium nickname or crest description is confirmed by two publishers.

voice.welcome: Come in under the white hill.

ground.name: Stadion pod Bijelim Brijegom
ground.line: The ground is in the Bijeli Brijeg district, on the west bank of the Neretva. It opened in 1958.

founded.line: Founded in 1905 as a student sports club, a football club called Zrinjski since 1912. Often named the oldest in Bosnia and Herzegovina.

emblem.line: The name comes from the Zrinski noble family, which is where The Nobles come from.

colours.line: A white shirt with a red sash across the chest.

terrace.name: The Standing Tribune
terrace.line: The Standing Tribune, the east end, was where the organised support stood from 1994 to 2023.
